<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תמוז_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919340_theRebbe_24" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_9E_D7_95_D7_96_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919340_theRebbe_24__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the drawing down through the arousal of many is not only beyond the chain of descent, but also comes from a place that the arousal from below does not reach.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And one must understand,</t>
    <t s="1">that even in the explanation</t>
    <t s="2">(at the beginning of the maamar)</t>
    <t s="3">that the arousal of the many draws down a more elevated light,</t>
    <t s="4">it explains that the drawing down through the arousal of the many is the Thirteen Attributes of Mercy,</t>
    <t s="5">for the Thirteen Attributes of Mercy are above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="6">and a drawing down that is above the chain of descent is not commensurate with the arousal,</t>
    <t s="7">and nevertheless he adds afterwards</t>
    <t s="8">(another matter)</t>
    <t s="9">that the drawing down through the many is not commensurate with the arousal of the many.</t>
    <t s="10">And the point of the explanation in this,</t>
    <t s="11">that the intention in this that he adds that the drawing down through the many is not commensurate with their arousal is,</t>
    <t s="12">that the drawing down through the many is not only that the drawing down is greater than the work</t>
    <t s="13">[this matter is in every drawing down that is above the chain of descent]</t>
    <t s="14">but also that the drawing down is</t>
    <t s="15">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="16">from the aspect of Above,</t>
    <t s="17">in the manner of</t>
    <t s="18">an arousal from Above from its own side that is drawn</t>
    <t s="19">from a place that the arousal from below does not reach there.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section compares the two levels of drawing down through the many to the two aspects of "I toiled and I found," where the finding is either in the place of toil or from a different place entirely.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it can be said that it is in the manner of the matter of "I toiled and I found,"</t>
    <t s="1">that the knowledge that comes through toil is in a manner of finding</t>
    <t s="2">("I found")</t>
    <t s="3">that is not commensurate with the toil,</t>
    <t s="4">and there are two modes in this.</t>
    <t s="5">The success in knowing and understanding the matter in which he toiled – in the manner of the advantage of the prayer of the many,</t>
    <t s="6">that the drawing down is above the chain of descent</t>
    <t s="7">(above order and gradation),</t>
    <t s="8">but</t>
    <t s="9">(only)</t>
    <t s="10">from this place to which the arousal reached.</t>
    <t s="11">And that the success in knowledge of Torah that comes through a person's toil is in a place in which he did not toil at all,</t>
    <t s="12">he toils in this place and his Torah toils for him from another place</t>
    <t s="13">– in the manner of the second matter of the prayer of the many,</t>
    <t s="14">that the drawing down through the work</t>
    <t s="15">(prayer),</t>
    <t s="16">is in the manner of an arousal from Above from its own side that the arousal from below</t>
    <t s="17">(even the arousal of the prayer of the many)</t>
    <t s="18">does not reach there.</t>
    <t s="19">Except that nevertheless this drawing down comes about through the prayer of the many,</t>
    <t s="20">similar to how also that his Torah toils for him in another place is through the toil of the person.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the two modes correspond to two levels within the Thirteen Attributes of Mercy, where the "one" added to the "twelve" either descends into them or elevates them into itself.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And it can be said that the distinction of these two matters is also in their root,</t>
    <t s="2">in the Thirteen Attributes of Mercy.</t>
    <t s="3">And the matter is,</t>
    <t s="4">that the number</t>
    <t s="5">thirteen</t>
    <t s="6">(the rectifications of the beard)</t>
    <t s="7">is twelve with one.</t>
    <t s="8">For twelve is the twelve oxen</t>
    <t s="9">(in Beriyah),</t>
    <t s="10">and the one</t>
    <t s="11">(that is added to the twelve)</t>
    <t s="12">is the sea that stands upon them</t>
    <t s="13">(Malchut of Atzilut).</t>
    <t s="14">And higher still,</t>
    <t s="15">twelve is the twelve diagonal boundaries in Atzilut,</t>
    <t s="16">and the one</t>
    <t s="17">(that is added to the twelve)</t>
    <t s="18">is above Atzilut.</t>
    <t s="19">And it can be said that this that thirteen is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="20">is,</t>
    <t s="21">that through the one that is added to the twelve,</t>
    <t s="22">also the twelve are above the chain of descent.</t>
    <t s="23">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="24">that there are two modes</t>
    <t s="25">(levels)</t>
    <t s="26">in this.</t>
    <t s="27">That the one is drawn into the twelve as they are in their place,</t>
    <t s="28">for in this manner,</t>
    <t s="29">even after the one is drawn into them,</t>
    <t s="30">they are a boundary</t>
    <t s="31">(diagonal boundaries),</t>
    <t s="32">except that through the one that is above the chain of descent being drawn into them, they have an unlimited power.</t>
    <t s="33">And another mode,</t>
    <t s="34">that the twelve are elevated and included in the one,</t>
    <t s="35">through which they exit their limitation and become in a state of without limit.</t>
    <t s="36">And it can be said that this is that "one" in gematria is thirteen,</t>
    <t s="37">that all thirteen are one.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
